parts.text: What can you do for our construction bid operations?
I can search and score stored bids, explain fit evidence, scan supported portals, and prepare Google Sheets or ClickUp action previews. External actions still require operator approval.
List our current high-fit drainage opportunities and explain why they rank well.
Push every bid to ClickUp now and delete the old tasks.
I cannot delete external records or approve my own writes. I can prepare a non-destructive ClickUp action proposal for your review and approval.
